rows.text: splits `ecx` into 2-bit fields a (bits 0-1), b (2-3), c (4-5), d (6-7), forms i = 27a + 9b + 3c + d and reads the 16-byte row i of the table at `00902750`; into the output o (the fifth (stack) argument) it copies row `+4` unchanged to dword `+8`, and writes row `+8` to dword `+0` and row `+0xC` to dword `+4`, both remapped 6 to `0x11`, 7 to `0x12`, 2 to `0xF`, 3 to `0x10`, other values unchanged; when row `+0` is 1 it stores 1 at `+4` of o if a is non-zero, else at `+0`; it stores row `+0` at `+0x1C`, replaced by 5 when the low byte of the sixth (stack) argument is non-zero and i is 10; when `+0x1C` is then 3 or 5 it stores 1 at `+0` and 0 at `+4`; finally it stores 0 at `+0x18` and bits 32-39 of `rcx` divided by 255 (`008C5B40`) as float at `+0xC`, `+0x10` and `+0x14`
copies the 16 dwords at `rdx+0` to `rdx+0x3C` into `+0x11C` to `+0x158` of `rcx`

copies the four dwords at `rdx+0` to `rdx+0xC` into the first four dwords of the `0x30`-byte element whose index is the signed dword `+0x1C0` of `rcx`, in the array at qword `+0x18` of `rcx` (re-reading index and base before each store)
computes `rcx + 0x10880` plus dword `+0x18860` of `rcx` (zero-extended) times `0x7FE0`, zeroes dword `+0x18860`, stores the pointer at qword `+0xB8` and returns it
stores `dl` at byte `+0x851` and `r8w` at word `+0x852` of `rcx`
copies the 16 dwords at `rdx+0` to `rdx+0x3C` into `+0x10` to `+0x4C` of `rcx`, stores byte 1 at `+0x208F3` and returns 0

notes: 001EE650: the function has no frame (no sub rsp), so [rsp+0x28] / [rsp+0x30] are the fifth and sixth arguments; the 64-bit rcx is kept in r9 and its bits 32-39 feed the float. The anchor cap of five leaves the final float stores (001EE7A2 divss, 001EE7AA..001EE7B4 movss) and the 3-or-5 override store (001EE777 mov) unanchored; 001EE770 test covers the 3-or-5 check (v-3 AND NOT 2 is zero). The second remap (on +4) duplicates the first at 001EE6F9-001EE730. Row stride 16 is idx*2*8 (001EE6A9 add r10,r10 with scale 8). 006CAC30: the entry instruction is the dl store, but the r8w store is interior, so it is rowed; FABLE may prefer to skip it as near-entry-only.
